title: Liew Dek Hao selected for the ECFA Winter Instrumentation School at CERN
text: Master's student Liew Dek Hao has been selected for ECFA-WISPP 2027, the first edition of the European Committee for Future Accelerators' two-week instrumentation school, held at CERN from 1 to 12 February 2027.

title: New preprint: machine learning for neutrino–antineutrino discrimination
text: Liew Dek Hao's first-author paper on machine-learning-assisted ν/ν̄ discrimination in atmospheric neutrino events, and its impact on CP-violation sensitivity in a 20-kton liquid-scintillator detector, is on arXiv:2611.11474.

title: Group research presented at NuFact 2026 in Shanghai
text: Liew Dek Hao presented the group's work on atmospheric neutrinos at NuFact 2026, the 27th International Workshop on Neutrinos from Accelerators, hosted by the Tsung-Dao Lee Institute, Shanghai (31 August – 5 September 2026).

title: Vietnam School on Neutrinos 2026
text: Liew Dek Hao attended the Vietnam School on Neutrinos (VSoN 2026) at ICISE, Quy Nhon, Vietnam, 14–24 July 2026.

title: Yong Jig Tian admitted to a PhD programme at Shanghai Jiao Tong University
text: Project student Yong Jig Tian, who worked on the development of Multi-gap Resistive Plate Chambers in the group, has been accepted into the doctoral programme at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

title: Adjunct appointment at Xiamen University, China
text: Dr. Nizam joined the Department of Physics of Xiamen University as Adjunct Assistant Professor.

title: Real-time radiation damage in diamond sensors published in JINST
text: Our study of monocrystalline CVD diamond sensors exposed to 67.5 MeV protons at the Crocker Nuclear Laboratory, UC Davis, appeared in JINST 19 (2024) P09018.

title: Joined Xiamen University Malaysia
text: Dr. Nizam joined the Department of Physics at Xiamen University Malaysia as Assistant Professor, continuing as Research Associate at SCIPP, UC Santa Cruz.
